scope: Exposed synthetic full rolling field ensembles; no observation fit or empirical holdout
inverse_policy: Report all conditions/errors; no guarantee of stable inversion or physical noise precision. Do not tune states or thresholds after outcomes.
state_policy: Each of five spectral shells has three bounded independent seed directions from a declared positive-definite S,V,T covariance. X and Z are independently assigned; solve only initial00 constraint. No physical cosmic preparation selected.
failure_policy: Preserve every attempted source, output and singular/ill-conditioned case; new versions preserve the same scientific case list unless explicitly declared as exposed development.
